meta.name: publish
meta.description: Publish oh-my-opencode to npm by triggering the GitHub Actions publish workflow and verifying its artifacts. Ship-only: never runs pre-publish-review or re-reviews merged code unless the user explicitly asks. Argument: <patch|minor|major>. Triggers: publish, release, deploy, npm publish.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 一键发布 npm 包到生产环境
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果维护 npm 包并需要自动化发布流程
copy.tagline_en: Publish npm packages to production with one click
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you maintain npm packages and need automated release

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会帮你把 oh-my-opencode 发布到 npm。它会触发 GitHub Actions 的发布流程，检查版本号（patch/minor/major），等待构建完成，然后验证 npm 包和 GitHub Release 是否成功，最后还会尝试在 Discord 发公告。
howto.when: 当你要求发布、部署或推送 npm 包时触发。你必须先告诉 Claude 版本升级类型（patch、minor 或 major），否则它会停下来问你。

say.text: 发布 patch 版本到 npm
say.note: Claude 会开始执行完整的发布流程。

say.text: 帮我部署 minor 版本
say.note: Claude 会确认版本类型后触发发布。

say.text: 发布 major 版本并检查结果
say.note: Claude 会发布并验证所有发布面。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will help you publish oh-my-opencode to npm. It triggers the GitHub Actions publish workflow, checks the version bump type (patch/minor/major), waits for the build, verifies npm packages and GitHub Release, and attempts a Discord announcement.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to publish, release, deploy, or npm publish. You must specify a bump type (patch, minor, or major); otherwise Claude will ask.

say_en.text: Publish a patch version to npm
say_en.note: Claude will start the full publish workflow.

say_en.text: Deploy a minor version for me
say_en.note: Claude will confirm the bump type and trigger the release.

say_en.text: Publish a major version and verify results
say_en.note: Claude will publish and verify all release surfaces.
